title: 50% off Various Food Items: e.g. El Jannah Chicken, Subway Subs, Grill'd Burgers @ DoorDash
body:
Deal: 50% off Various Food Items: e.g. El Jannah Chicken, Subway Subs, Grill'd Burgers @ DoorDash

[bargainatoraah] Wow a whole el jannah chicken is only $34
[Fooah] Would've been a much better concept if the 50% off item was allowed to be added multiple times. Anything else you add just kills the deal.
[Puglife] Wow $16.50 delivered for a burger that cost $14 in store. But its 50% off so its a bargain.
I have no idea how people haven't figured out yet that these delivery companies are the biggest rort.
[Skumzy] People know, they're just too used to the convenience now
[eecan] Frangos - $13 Original Burger in store + credit card payment surcharge
Doordash pickup - $7.15 ($5.72 after Costco 20% giftcards)
no delivery/service fee
Doordash delivery - $12.86 ($10.29 after Costco 20% giftcards)
$7.15 Burger + $3.99 Delivery Fee + $1.72 Service fee
Sure there are other items that are a rip off but it isn't that hard to find stuff that's cheaper than in store during these deals.
[Big-Deal] Just pick up that's much cheaper than in store. Even without pickup allowed at subway I can't get a cheaper footlong than this delivered, at store
[pharcyde] Dunno what planet you live on but $2.50 for delivery is pretty good.
[MILKAPIG] $2.50 for private chauffeur for my single burger not bad
[ronnknee] $2.50 for otherwise a half an hour return trip to the store? Not bad.
[FutureTech] Remember people picking up is a fee free option. Paired with 20% off gift card from Costco is a pretty decent deal
[Josh2001] My Costco app doesn’t have the DoorDash gift cards the last few days, did you know why?
[iseeyou1312] I bought one yesterday, looked today and Doordash giftcards have been removed. The end of an era :*(
[masteraj] Exactly. Doordash is a rort if you're buying overpriced items with delivery on a credit card, then of course it's not a bargain. But if you take the time to wade through the junk deals and set them up wisely with costco gift cards and free delivery/pick-up, you can save quite a bit on meals and groceries.
[Esstee] I ordered El Jannah whole chicken. They delivered someone else's Woolworths order instead. So I submitted online form accordingly and they just said, no compensation offered. So sad. Any ideas on what can I do?
Fyi. The groceries consisted of bin bags and dish soap. Not even that rewarding.
[Mjk698] UNLUCKY.. I've heard of people getting a whole lot of shopping delivered on accident and WW just replace it and the lucky person got free food..
[spaceinvader2054] Here are two more participating stores:
Zeus Street Greek (50% off Tzimmy Chicken)
Ooshman (50% off (Halal) Pepperoni Burst and Super Supreme pizza)
The T&C's for the 50% off deals also state one use per account but you can order twice from the same store in different transactions.
